identity.title: List of Pokémon Adventures Sword & Shield volumes

leadText: The of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by Shogakukan in Japan. The volume releases began on June 26, 2020, and later ended on July 28, 2023. Once the ends in the regular volumes, the Sword & Shield arc will be properly collected in that format as well.
